name: Machine Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit in a lever lat pulldown machine with your thighs secured snugly beneath the pads and grasp the overhead handles with an underhand palms-facing-you grip.
Sit tall with your arms extended overhead and shoulder blades elevated slightly into a stretch.
Pull the handles smoothly downward toward your upper chest while keeping your elbows tucked in front of your torso.
Raise the handles slowly back to full arm extension under full control.
tips: Keep your torso upright with only a subtle lean back rather than rocking rearward.
Draw your elbows down toward your ribs to keep focus on the lats rather than only the biceps.
